name: Campingplatz Fohnsee 2
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Fohnsee 2 is located in the Austrian federal state of Tirol and is a seasonally operated site for vacationers. The facility is in a rural setting with views of the surrounding mountain ranges of the Alpen. Several marked hiking trails run nearby and can be used for day trips in summer. The atmosphere at the site is quiet and functional, without special leisure facilities. The amenities include sanitary facilities as well as pitches for motorhomes and tents, some with electricity hookup. Access to the nearest ski areas is only possible by car. Guests should expect simple infrastructure focused on basic supplies.
